name: 单词接龙
tagline: 每个单词都以上一个单词的最后一个字母开头。
description: 免费玩单词接龙：用最后一个字母把单词连起来，可以和朋友在同一设备上或在线玩，也可以和机器人对战。
about: Word Chain is the word game of linking words: each word must start with the last letter of the word before. Say "apple" and the next player needs a word starting with E, such as "eagle", and the next one with E again.

Every word must be a real word from the dictionary, three letters or more, and not said already this game. Stuck? Pass, and lose one of your three lives. Lose all three and you're out; the last player in wins.

Play with two to eight players: friends on one device or online, or bots at three levels. Word Chain is played in English and Bulgarian. A game ends after 80 words at most, and then the most lives left wins, then the most words said.
howToPlay: Choose the language of the words. The first letter is drawn at random.
On your turn, type a word that starts with the letter shown. It's checked as you type.
Press Enter or Play word. The word's last letter is the next player's first.
No word? Pass, and lose a life. With a clock on, running out of time passes for you.
Lose all three lives and you're out. The last player in wins; after 80 words, the most lives left wins.
controls: Type a word with your keyboard or your phone's, and press Enter.
In Bulgarian, a keyboard without Cyrillic types phonetically (A gives А).
Play word plays it; Pass gives up your turn for a life.
tips: Hand on hard letters: words ending in X, Z, J or Q leave the next player few choices.
Long words aren't worth more, so a short, sure word is fine.
Keep a few words ready for the common letters, like S, T and E.
Words already said can't be used again, so the easy ones run out as the game goes on.
In Bulgarian, a word ending in Ь or Ъ hands on the letter before it.

faq.question: Is Word Chain free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Which words count?
faq.answer: Real words from the game's dictionary in that language, three letters or more, not offensive, and not said already this game. Plurals and other forms count.

faq.question: What happens when I pass?
faq.answer: You lose one of your three lives, and the next player gets the same letter.

faq.question: Can I play alone?
faq.answer: Yes, against one to seven bots: easy, medium or hard.

faq.question: Which languages can I play in?
faq.answer: English and Bulgarian for now. More languages are coming with their dictionaries.
